feeds.title: A Frog in the Fjord
feeds.description: My name is Lorelou Desjardins. I am The Frog in the Fjord: a French lady who lived in Denmark for a bit before moving to Norway for good. This blog is about all these new realities foreigners like me face when trying to adapt to a new culture, language, country and most of all to new people.

feeds.title: Caroline Berg Eriksen
feeds.description: My name is Caroline Berg Eriksen and I´m an influencer, designer and entrepreneur, running one of Norway's biggest social media channels. This is a blog with a little insight into my everyday life. I am passionate about fashion, exercise, health and food, so these are also elements I spice up my blog with.

feeds.title: Tone Damli
feeds.description: The blog by Tone Damli features articles on fashion and beauty, motherhood, parenting, lifestyle, tips and tricks and more.

feeds.title: MAMMA PÅ HJUL
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog. A blog about life for better or worse. At the age of 36, my world was turned upside down. Follow me on my journey where I do not let the disease ALS stop me from living.

feeds.title: Camilla Pihl
feeds.description: Camilla Pihl is Norway's award-winning blogger and a passionate designer, dreamer, entrepreneur, and model, who shares tips about travel, beauty, food, fashion, and lifestyle.
